notes: Added missing stories to meet minimum and complete lifecycle coverage (schema, core logic, API, integration).

GOV-F-003-S161.title: Brain Lock Schema and Ownership Contract
GOV-F-003-S161.description: Define MongoDB schema for Brain lock records including lock_id, owner_id, TTL expiry timestamp, heartbeat timestamp, and status fields. Establish ownership contract ensuring single active owner and explicit expiration semantics.

GOV-F-003-S162.title: Core Lock TTL and Heartbeat Logic
GOV-F-003-S162.description: Implement lock acquisition, TTL expiration checks, and heartbeat renewal logic. Ensure expired locks can be safely reclaimed and active locks are protected via periodic heartbeat updates.

GOV-F-003-S163.title: Lock Acquisition and Release API
GOV-F-003-S163.description: Expose internal APIs for acquiring, renewing (heartbeat), releasing, and force-recovering locks. Enforce ownership validation and reject invalid or stale operations.

GOV-F-003-S164.title: Crash Recovery and Orphaned Lock Cleanup
GOV-F-003-S164.description: Implement recovery mechanism to detect orphaned locks (no heartbeat within TTL) and safely reassign ownership. Include background cleanup job to purge stale lock records.
